duration.$description: How long a hover, a toggle or a small entrance takes. Not for the flash of an action: use motion.light.

easing.$description: The curve of hover and toggle transitions. Goes with motion.hover.duration.

light.$description: The flash that marks an action: one place sets its duration, curve and intensity.

duration.$description: How long the flash of an action lasts. Only for light(); not for state changes, which the color carries.

easing.$description: The curve of the flash of an action. Only for light().

intensity.$description: How strongly the flash mixes the element's color into its glow. Only for light().

height.$description: The block size of buttons, inputs and selects, so they line up in a row. Not for icons or text.

height-sm.$description: The block size of small buttons and the side of icon buttons. Not to shrink an input: keep inputs at control.height.
